status: Validated and onset-aligned 84 human low-E strokes, rendered matching EG-089 controls and ablations, and attributed the main mismatch to an overly bright, fast-decaying modal core rather than additive pick layers. The next gate is an offline 2x2 modal-envelope/decay experiment.

projectState.summary: Plan 0104 shows that EG-089's real low-E gap is modal: about 1.6 kHz attack centroid versus 220-262 Hz in the captured DI, 45-62% versus under 1% above 1.5 kHz, and decay two to four times too fast. Direct pick-layer ablations are negligible. Build an offline current/envelope/decay/both fixture next, then require human listening.
